name: comp-478
title: Filterable Table
blurb: Data table with text search, range filters, and sortable columns.
description: Keyword research table with multi-type filters: text search for keywords, select dropdown for intent tags, and min/max range inputs for volume/CPC/traffic. Columns are sortable with aria-sort attributes.
use_when: Large datasets that require users to filter by multiple column types and sort interactively.
avoid_when: When data is dynamic and needs real-time backend filtering — filtering is client-side only.
a11y: Column headers are keyboard-accessible for sorting (Enter/Space). Range inputs have aria-labels. Intent tags use hardcoded foreground colors with good contrast.
